processing: Original PNGs copied byte-for-byte. Python reads alpha/bounding boxes and writes JSON only. Godot slices original cells, uses one fixed scale per source sheet, aligns soles (.5,.82), concatenates the painted contact and passing poses. No mirrored views, repaint, background removal, single-pose translation or crossfade synthesis.
quality_boundary: Two-frame contact/passing walk is deliberately sparse, with actual different leg positions but no full left/right four-phase cycle, attack/hurt/down animation or polished transition continuity. Independently generated supplemental cloth folds vary slightly. Four directional idle poses, same-variant portraits. Jiangzhou ordinary civilian crowd not generated; existing named hero sprites cannot substitute.

visual_qa.checked: Generated sources and normalized SE/NW Dong, SW/NW Xue strips and both portraits; actual alpha analysis rejects no selected sources. Brown backdrop RGB in Dong correction has alpha=0 outside figures; not an opaque matte. Staff placement and genuine leg motion reviewed, no automatic hash claim of smoothness.
visual_qa.shape_limits: Different generated sheets retain slight cloth-fold and shoulder-width changes; sparse two-frame walk. No complete opposing-stride cycle or attack set.
